name: cursor-ai-cost-optimizer
description: Cuts your Cursor AI bill: routes each request to the cheapest model tier that can do it well, with quality guardrails. Sets up in Cursor's user-level config (nothing written into projects) or per project.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Writes .cursor/ files and installs hooks that execute a binary.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a local .cursor/ folder and a local hook runtime.

enumDescriptions: Use the bundled cco-hook binary when this build ships one for your platform, otherwise Node.js.
Always use the bundled binary (fails if this build has none for your platform).
Always run hooks with `node .cursor/cco-hook.mjs` (Node.js >= 18 must be on the PATH Cursor sees). Keeps .cursor/hooks.json portable for teammates.
cco.hookRuntime.markdownDescription: How the CCO hook entries in `.cursor/hooks.json` are executed. `auto` uses `node .cursor/cco-hook.mjs` when Node.js >= 18 is available (portable for teammates) and falls back to the bundled `cco-hook` binary, which makes the hook entries reference a machine-local path. Changing this takes effect on the next **Set Up / Update** or activation-time doctor run.

cco.nodePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the Node.js executable used to run the plugin's setup scripts (`cco-init`, discovery). Default: `node` on PATH, then Cursor's own Node runtime. Ignored when `#cco.hookRuntime#` is `binary`.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AI Cost Optimizer
walkthroughs.description: Turn it on, start a new chat, and steer with [cco:fast] / [cco:deep] when you want to.

steps.title: Set up in this workspace
steps.description:
Writes the routing rule, tier subagents and hooks under .cursor/ (nothing outside your project). You confirm the file list first.
[Set Up / Update in This Workspace](command:cco.installCursorAssets)

steps.title: Start a new chat and work normally
steps.description: Keep your usual chat model. Each routed task ends with one line like `[cco: FAST → composer-2.5 • 0.3x of your chat model • est. $0.02]`. Risky work is always sent to the strong tier.

steps.title: Steer when you want to
steps.description:
Force a tier with [cco:fast], [cco:balanced] or [cco:deep] anywhere in a prompt; [cco:auto] restores routing, [cco:off] bypasses it for one request.
[Insert [cco:fast]](command:cco.insertOverrideFast)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node --test test/unit/binary.test.js test/unit/install.test.js test/unit/pricing.test.js test/unit/scorer.test.js test/unit/userScope.test.js test/unit/selfcheck.test.js
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm run compile
